newsitem.title: CHINA: China launches Tibet highway repair project.
newsitem.headline: China launches Tibet highway repair project.

text.p: China has launched a 500 million yuan ($60 million) repair project for its highway linking Tibet to Qinghai province, the official Xinhua news agency said.
It said the project would repair 204 km of the 1,147 km highway, the main road link to the remote region. An earlier phase of the project spent 850 million yuan to repair 334 km.
Some 740 km of the road has been built in permafrost zones at altitudes of 4,500 to 5,000 meters, the news agency said.
The road is also heavily used by the army to resupply its forces in the restive Himalayan region.
